messages:
Rhea (partnerships): VectorForge reached out about a joint bench: VF-900 liquid-cooled blade. They want a public perf/W + tokens/s piece plus a short methods appendix. Goal: 3-week turnaround. Who can scope a compact matrix that still shows signal? @Diego @Min @Sage. Arjun, what telemetry/hardware can you provide?
Arjun (VectorForge): We can provide 3 blades in our SF lab (VF-900 v1.0) with factory liquid loop, firmware 0.9. PDUs and rack-level meter available. We can also expose on-chip power counters and a profiler `vf-prof`. Embargo: early July preferred.
Diego (eng-runtime): Minimal credible matrix: 3 models (redwood-open-7b, mixtral-16b, llamaX-70b), two quant modes (int8, int4), three batch sizes (1,8,16). Kernel variants: stock, vf-sparse-attn, vf-tiling-gemm. Capture tokens/s (sustained), p95 token latency, avg power (W), energy/token. Also want a sustained 20-minute run for "sustained" numbers to show thermal behavior.
Min (eng-ml): We'll run deterministic eval prompts and report delta-perplexity / delta-ROUGE. For int4 include calibration steps and a small section about prompt sensitivity. Gate: if int4 quality drop >3% vs int8, add a visible footnote.
Sage (eng-infra): Telemetry requirements: PDU at 1s, chip counters at 500ms if possible, ambient rack temp, inlet water temp, and wall power. Ingest format: JSONL with run_id, ts, host_ms, chip_power_w, rack_temp_c. We'll tag runs with firmware_rev and kernel_variant. Alert on >12% power variance or thermal throttling during sustained run.
Lina (marketing): For the public story we want a canonical quoted run and a small methods appendix. Also curious if liquid cooling gives a performance-per-watt advantage at higher sustained loads. Arjun: can you provide water inlet temps and pump RPM logs?
Arjun (VectorForge): Yes, we'll share inlet temp and pump RPM telemetry. VF-900 firmware 0.9 exposes counters A..K. We can gate telemetry behind lab ACL. We'll sign an embargo agreement.
Rhea (partnerships): Proposed schedule: week1 dry-run (7b small matrix), week2 full runs incl sustained 20-mins, week3 validation + writeup + legal + marketing. Early July embargo target. Owners? Diego runbook, Min evals, Sage telemetry, Lina partner comms, Arjun hardware.
Diego (eng-runtime): I'll draft runbook and kernel toggle matrix. Example run command to capture metadata:
```bash
./run_bench --model llamaX-70b \
  --quant int8 \
  --kernel vf-tiling-gemm \
  --batch 8 \
  --duration 1200 \
  --out s3://redwood-benching/vectorforge/vf900/{run_ts}/ \
  --tag run_id=vf900-1965004321
```
Diego (eng-runtime): I'll also add `--sustained` flag for 20-minute steady-state capture and wire `vf-prof --snap` pre/post.
Min (eng-ml): I'll prepare eval prompts and the quality-check script. We'll lock deterministic seeds and an eval harness in bench/evals/vectorforge. Gate: if sustained run shows >5% perf degradation over 20min, note thermal effects.
Sage (eng-infra): I'll set up the ingestion bucket and dashboard, and add alerts: missing telemetry -> fail run; thermal throttling -> fail and escalate. Also will log inlet water temp and pump RPM.
Ops Bot: bench-run queued: id=vf900-1965004321, owner=diego, matrix=3models x {int8,int4} x 3batch-sizes, sustained=20m on select samples.
Arjun (VectorForge): Lab available Mon (1965080000). We'll provide ACL and `vf-prof` binary. Pump/inlet telemetry will be on the metrics endpoint.
Lina (marketing): I'll draft a short embargoed blog outline + visuals we want (throughput vs watt, energy/token heatmap). Legal: please prepare a partner embargo template.
Rhea (partnerships): Action items recap in-thread: Diego runbook + kernel matrix, Min evals + seeds, Sage telemetry + alerts, Arjun hardware + ACL, Lina marketing copy. Next sync after dry-run artifacts. :thumbsup:
Diego (eng-runtime): Will upload runbook by EOD tomorrow.
Min (eng-ml): Eval prompts in repo later today.
Arjun (VectorForge): Sending ACL and prof binary now.
Sage (eng-infra): Spinning up bucket and dashboards.
Rhea (partnerships): Thanks all, closing thread for now. Post updates here.
